'''Manalin''' was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Joralla system/Legends|Joralla system]],<ref name="TSWPC" /> a part of the [[Mektrun sector/Legends|Mektrun sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Manalin occupied the closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]], the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]]&ndash;type star [[Jaska]], and had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The [[Temperature/Legends|searing-hot]] planet had a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and was considered to have no commercial value.<ref name="TSWPC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Manalin was first mentioned in ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]'', a [[1991]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Joralla [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Manalin, in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
